vatSetup.title: VAT Setup
vatSetup.exemptTitle: Good news — you no need file VAT return!
vatSetup.exemptBody: If your business dey below 100 million naira, you no need submit VAT return. But you still need collect 7.5% VAT for invoice.
vatSetup.requiredBody: Your business must file VAT return before 21st of every month.

einvoice.title: E-Invoice — New Law
einvoice.phaseSmall: This one no dey compulsory for your business size until 2027. But if you start now, bank fit trust your records more.
einvoice.phaseMedium: Pilot phase don start. E go compulsory by July 1 2026. Apply for FIRSMBS integration now.
einvoice.phaseLarge: ⚠️ E-INVOICE DON BECOME LAW. If you no comply, NRS fit fine you.
einvoice.platform: Na FIRSMBS (NRS Merchant-Buyer Solution) dem dey use
